verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a first-party MCP server that lets users "query Ramp data and take actions with natural language" from ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants. The support article gives concrete natural-language prompts: "Lock my card — I can't find it", "Show me our top software vendors by spend this quarter", and drafting reminders for missing receipts. The AI Agents guide covers reads, approvals, edits, policy Q&A and purchases, and a live probe confirms the OAuth-gated server at mcp.ramp.com exposes granular read/write scopes. missing for 10: no native in-product natural-language command interface (language understanding comes from external assistants), bill approvals not yet available via MCP, no independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
